title: Outer preparation run
statement: Let $C,e$ be natural numbers, let $m$ be a Boolean, let $f$ map Boolean words to Boolean words, and let $z,t$ be Boolean words. Set $h=\langle z,t\rangle$, $a=2|z|+2$, $c=(2C+3)(|h|+1)^{e+1}$, and $B=8(2C+3)(|h|+1)^{e+1}$. Starting with register $0$ equal to $a$, all other registers zero, no result, and state “copy” at stage $0$ with no increment pending, there is a finite run to state “tail test” with its flag true and no result. At the endpoint, registers $0,2,3,7,8$ equal $a,a,2|z|,c,|h|+1$, respectively, register $1$ equals $|h|$, and all other registers are zero; every configuration before the endpoint satisfies the program’s state precondition and has every register at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps Boolean words to Boolean words
The initial register values are register $0=a$ and all others zero
The initial state is copy, stage $0$, with no increment pending and no result
The run’s intermediate configurations satisfy the program precondition and register bound $B$

Let $C,e$ be natural numbers, let $m$ be a Boolean parameter, let $f$ map bit strings to
bit strings, and let $z,t$ be bit strings. For input $h=\langle z,t\rangle$, start with

increment pending. The program has a bounded safe run to state “tail test” with its
register vector set as follows: registers $0$ and $2$ equal $2|z|+2$, register $1$
equals $|h|$, register $3$ equals $2|z|$, register $7$ equals $(2C+3)(|h|+1)^{e+1}$,
register $8$ equals $|h|+1$, and all other registers are zero. The register bound
throughout the run is $8(2C+3)(|h|+1)^{e+1}$.
